name: cactus
description: A saguaro cactus: a tall pleated column with a domed top and arms that grow out, bend at an elbow and rise parallel to the trunk, every part ribbed with sharp grooves and round crests, and a crown of waxy white flowers with yellow centres on the trunk and arm tips in May and June. The arm count, their heights and their reach come from a seed, so a stand of saguaros never repeats; with no arms it is a young spear.

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the trunk in metres (a saguaro grows 12-18 m at most; arms appear from about 4-5 m).

params.name: radius
params.description: Trunk radius in metres at its widest (a grown saguaro is 0.3-0.4).

params.name: arms
params.description: Number of arms (0 is a young saguaro without arms).

params.name: armHeight
params.description: Where the arms start, as a share of the height.

params.name: armReach
params.description: How far and how high the arms reach (1 is typical).

params.name: ribs
params.description: Number of ribs (pleats) on the trunk; saguaros have 12-30.

params.name: seed
params.description: Seed for the arm positions, heights and lengths.

params.name: flowers
params.description: White flowers on the trunk and arm tips (the bloom in May and June).
